note: 系列 A 例句軌 A2 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: Yesterday I walked to school with my friend.
items.zh: 昨天我和朋友走路去學校。

items.sentence: I am going to visit my grandma on Sunday.
items.zh: 我星期天要去看奶奶。

items.sentence: My brother is taller than me.
items.zh: 我哥哥比我高。

items.sentence: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
items.zh: 我很累，所以我早早就去睡了。

items.sentence: We bought some fruit at the market.
items.zh: 我們在市場買了一些水果。

items.sentence: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
items.zh: 我喜歡茶，但我不喜歡咖啡。

items.sentence: She is faster than her sister.
items.zh: 她跑得比她姊姊快。

items.sentence: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
items.zh: 外面在下雨，所以我們待在家裡。

items.sentence: I did my homework after dinner.
items.zh: 我晚餐後寫了功課。

items.sentence: We are going to watch a movie tonight.
items.zh: 我們今晚要看一部電影。

items.sentence: This book is more interesting than that one.
items.zh: 這本書比那本更有趣。

items.sentence: I cleaned my room this morning.
items.zh: 我今天早上整理了房間。

items.sentence: My feet hurt because I walked a lot.
items.zh: 我的腳很痛，因為我走了很多路。

items.sentence: Can you help me find my keys?
items.zh: 你可以幫我找鑰匙嗎？

items.sentence: We played soccer in the park yesterday.
items.zh: 我們昨天在公園踢足球。

items.sentence: I want to buy a new bike.
items.zh: 我想買一台新腳踏車。

items.sentence: The weather is colder today than yesterday.
items.zh: 今天天氣比昨天更冷。

items.sentence: She sang a song at the party.
items.zh: 她在派對上唱了一首歌。

items.sentence: I am going to call my friend later.
items.zh: 我等一下要打電話給朋友。

items.sentence: My mom made a cake for my birthday.
items.zh: 我媽媽為我的生日做了一個蛋糕。

items.sentence: We can take the train to the city.
items.zh: 我們可以搭火車去市區。

items.sentence: I forgot my umbrella at home.
items.zh: 我把雨傘忘在家裡了。

items.sentence: He is good at drawing pictures.
items.zh: 他很會畫圖。

items.sentence: Turn left and the shop is there.
items.zh: 左轉，商店就在那裡。

items.sentence: I felt happy when I saw my dog.
items.zh: 看到我的狗時我覺得很開心。

items.sentence: We need to buy some milk and eggs.
items.zh: 我們需要買一些牛奶和雞蛋。

items.sentence: The test was easy, so I was happy.
items.zh: 考試很簡單，所以我很開心。

items.sentence: I usually get up early on weekends.
items.zh: 我週末通常很早起床。

items.sentence: My sister helped me with my homework.
items.zh: 我姊姊幫我做功課。

items.sentence: We went to the beach last summer.
items.zh: 我們去年夏天去了海邊。
